customManagers.description: Stalwart's newest release, pinned by its digest, which the job contract-newest tests (NEWEST in xtask/src/lab.rs).

prBodyNotes: The job contract-newest runs Garrison's contract tests against this image. Once they pass, "Supporting a new Stalwart release" in CONTRIBUTING.md makes a new release a supported one.
packageRules.description: A new Stalwart release, or a new image of it, gets its contract tests at once: no waiting time, no schedule.
Exact versions for npm packages only. Cargo keeps its ranges and updates Cargo.lock, and the engines range stays open (Renovate's default for both).
TypeScript 7 lacks the compiler API that typescript-eslint and openapi-typescript need (CONTRIBUTING.md).
